statement: T1_TREND_INTRADAY: the multi-day trend premium partly accrues during the US day session; holding the daily trend direction only from 09:00 CT to 15:00 CT (Topstep-compatible: flat before 3:10 PM CT) keeps a positive net edge.
mechanism: trend premium accrual during the day session
falsification: {"DEV": "pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 60% instruments with positive net mean", "VAL": "pooled net Sharpe >= 0.3", "TEST": "net Sharpe > 0 at 1x and >= 0 at 2x", "FRESH": "pooled net mean > 0"}
